title: Germany — Bürgergeld (SGB II) rate by nationality
source: Bundesagentur für Arbeit, Migrationsmonitor — Tabelle 1.3 (SGB II-Quote) & Tabelle 4.1 / Zeitreihe rT4_1 (ELB)
definition: SGB II-Quote = Leistungsberechtigte (Bürgergeld) as a share of each nationality’s population in Germany (Germans: Bevölkerungsfortschreibung ages 0 to under statutory retirement age; foreigners: AZR ages 0 to under 65). This is a within-group rate, not the share of all recipients.
note: Viral charts titled “Bürgergeld-Empfänger nach Staatsangehörigkeit” often reuse these rates while implying they are shares of all recipients. They are not: rates do not sum to 100%. In February 2025, German nationals were still 52.5% of erwerbsfähige Leistungsberechtigte (ELB).
chartNote: February 2025 SGB II-Quote from BA Migrationsmonitor time series. A widely shared graphic showed Germany at 5.3% (matching Jan/Mar/May 2025); the February figure is 5.4%.

elbRecipients.note: Erwerbsfähige Leistungsberechtigte (ELB) — working-age Bürgergeld recipients. German share of ELB was 52.5% in February 2025 (BA rT4_1).
